listId.description: ListID creates the contact in this list when no contact there has the email.

averageReadTime.description: Average time between open and click

botOpens.description: 🤖 Machine events left out of every count above

repeatClicks.description: Number of times same user clicked

untracked.description: sent without open/click tracking; excluded from rates

internal_handlers.InviteUserRequest.description: Send an invitation email to a user to join a team

autoDeclareWinner.description: Automatically declare winner when threshold met

exitOnGoal.description: ExitOnGoal makes a contact leave when they reach one of the workflow's goals; nil means yes.

liveVersion.description: Nodes and Edges hold the draft; LiveVersion names the published snapshot new contacts start on.

reentryMode.description: ReentryMode is "once", "after_finish" or "after_days"; empty (older workflows) behaves as "after_finish".

archiveNewsletterId.description: ArchiveNewsletterID publishes a one-off campaign in that newsletter's web archive.

pauseReason.description: PauseReason says why staged sending paused the campaign.

sendInStages.description: SendInStages: nil sends in stages automatically to never-mailed lists.

stage.description:
Stage counts staged-sending stages cleared; NextStageAt is when the
next stage's results check is due.

trackEngagement.description: TrackEngagement: nil or true adds the open pixel and click-tracking links.

timezone.description: IANA name; automations send in it

skipped.description: rows left out, counted by reason

machine.description:
🤖 Machine traffic: empty for people, otherwise TrackingMachineBot or
TrackingMachineProxy. Reports and list cleanup count only machine=''.

listCleanup.description: ListCleanup asks long-silent readers once, then stops emailing them. Nil means on.

limit.description: Optional limit for the feature (e.g., number of campaigns)

scope.description: Scope defines the permission level, e.g. "read:campaigns", "write:templates"

trackingConsentMode.description: TrackingConsentMode is none, opt_out or opt_in; see ShouldTrack.
